title: 第1077章 铁家加大助力第1076章 临时堂口
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 楚风要是不在这边三分三合，这逆徒却是还当真以为他做师尊的丁点儿脾气都没有，那才是令人笑掉大牙。
随后，楚风淡淡的目光又再落到了其他几人的身上去。
紧接着，一个个的也都是齐齐开口，忙不迭地表明他们一个个绝对是无辜的。
“师尊方才之事，这些都是大师兄一人所为。跟徒儿们实在是没有关系的，师尊可千万不要迁怒于我们。”
“师尊放心，传扬太古仙道事宜绝对会被我们给完成的。若是让师尊失望了，我们这些做徒弟的一个个的岂不是难辞其咎？
这样一种设想，断然不能够发生。决然不能够。”
看着面前的这些徒弟们个个脸色坚毅无比，此时此刻的楚风才露出了心满意足的笑容。
总算不那么像那几个逆徒了，否则的话，若是人人都如同大徒弟萧火火这般，整个太古仙道恐怕全都是一身反骨了。
届时，楚风他不被活生生的气死，那才是成了怪事一桩。
楚风摆了摆手，这些徒弟们一个个也就此离开。
而离开之后，柳清舞撇了撇嘴，稍稍带着几分怨念，目光不免得也就看向了自家大师兄的方向：“师尊老人家的的确确是有些偏心的，什么都第一个给大师兄，哪里还有我们的份？
人家不过只是想让师尊对咱们一个个的也好上那么一丢丢，难道这样的想法也是有错吗？”
柳清舞做可怜兮兮的模样。
旁边的林云丽，还有叶凡几人轻轻咳嗽了一声，没好气地看了他柳清舞一眼，紧接着才是继续说明情况：“行了，师尊老人家不在这边，装给谁看？
况且，大师兄这么多年以来一直都代替师尊教导我们，所以我个人觉得没毛病。”
“好了，传扬仙道，赶快兑换其他的大罗之境精元，才是我们当下最应该做的事情。
师尊这一回可是都成了赘婿，我们这些做徒弟的要是不好好的再努力一把，师尊的脸面又该往哪里放？”
随着叶凡开了金口，其他的这些徒弟们才算是或多或少的承认下来。
紧接着，一个个的开始继续忙碌。
只是区区几日功夫，太古仙道在这青茅山附近数座城池，可以说是彻底铺遍了。
除了熊家、白家还有铁家的势力范围之外，其余的各方，无论大小，三流二流或者一流，多数也全部都被楚风的那些徒弟们给一一占据。
偏偏他们一个个的采用的还是比较温和的方式，再加上太古仙道本身也就是降维性打击，所带来的效果当然是无与伦比。
content_en:
If Chu Feng wasn't here to make three points, this traitor would really think that he didn't have any temper as a master, which would be ridiculous.
Then, Chu Feng's indifferent eyes fell on the other people again.
Immediately afterwards, everyone spoke in unison, hastily proving that each of them was absolutely innocent.
"What Master just did, these are all done by Senior Brother alone. They really have nothing to do with the disciples. Master, please don't vent your anger on us."
"Master, don't worry, we will definitely complete the matter of spreading the Taikoo Immortal Way. If Master is disappointed, wouldn't all of us who are disciples bear the blame?
Such an idea absolutely cannot happen. Absolutely not. "
Seeing the resolute expressions on the faces of the disciples in front of him, Chu Feng showed a satisfied smile at this moment.
Finally, he is no longer like those rebellious disciples. Otherwise, if everyone were like the eldest disciple Xiao Huohuo, the entire Taikoo Immortal Way would probably be rebellious.
By then, if Chu Feng is not angry to death, it will be a strange thing.
Chu Feng waved his hand, and these disciples left one by one.
After leaving, Liu Qingwu curled her lips, with a bit of resentment, and her eyes couldn't help but look in the direction of her senior brother: "Master is indeed a bit biased. He is the first to give everything to senior brother, so where is our share?
We just want Master to treat each of us a little better. Is this idea wrong? "
Liu Qingwu looked pitiful.
Lin Yunli and Ye Fan next to them coughed lightly, glanced at Liu Qingwu angrily, and then continued to explain the situation: "Okay, Master is not here, who can I pretend to?
Besides, Senior Brother has been teaching us on behalf of Master for so many years, so I personally think there is nothing wrong with it. "
"Okay, spreading the immortal way and exchanging other Da Luo realm essences quickly is what we should do now.
Master has become a son-in-law this time. If we disciples don't work hard and work hard, where will Master's face be put? "
As Ye Fan opened his mouth, the other disciples more or less admitted it.
Immediately afterwards, one by one began to continue to be busy.
…
In just a few days, it can be said that the Taikoo Immortal Path has been completely spread throughout several cities near Qingmao Mountain.
In addition to the spheres of influence of the Xiong family, the Bai family, and the Tie family, most of the other parties, no matter how big or small, third-rate, second-rate, or first-rate, were all occupied by Chu Feng's disciples.
However, each of them adopted a relatively mild method. In addition, the Taikoo Immortal Way itself is a dimensionality reduction strike, and the effect it brings is of course unparalleled.
